tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidders must have completed similar goods and services such as the supply of food for a continuous period of 12 months during any of the preceding three financial years 2022-23 2023-24 or 2024-25 This should have been carried out for a government department such as a Town Municipal Councils, Government Hospital, Government Hostel, Government Canteen, or any other Central, State, or PSU department, with a minimum value of 50 percent of the estimated contract amount, i.e., Rs. 4.90 lakhs
GST Registration Certificate and PAN Card
Tenderer Should have registered with Statutory authorities in Karnataka/GOI as indicated below and scanned copy of necessary proof such as Valid Trade License or Food license

The bidder should submit Self declaration letter on company letter head stating that Company or firm is neither blacklisted nor name proposed for black listing during last 3 years by any Government or Semi-Government or Government Undertaking or Public Sector Organizations or any other Departments in India
